[NDBG.11.1.1] A step moves the session one unit of the current
granularity ([NDBG.14.1.1]). That unit is one RHS **action** in replay and
one **pump** in a live session, unless the client sets another.

| DAP operation | DS meaning |
|---|---|
| `next` | Move forward one step at the current granularity |
| `stepIn` | In replay: go to the first later firing whose match includes a fact the current action asserted, passing the firings between. `stepInTargets` lists every firing the action caused; the default target is the earliest |
| `stepOut` | In replay: run until every firing the current firing caused, directly or transitively, within the current pump has fired, then stop at the next firing |
| `stepBack` | Move back one step at the current granularity ([NDBG.14r.3.1]) |
| `continue` | Run forward to the next breakpoint |
| `reverseContinue` | Run back to the most recent breakpoint ([NDBG.14r]) |

Behind the end of a live run, a forward step moves through the recorded run,
and at its end the session carries on live.
